correctness.rationale: Reconstructed actual source six-dimensional reduced Jacobian and independently formed the invertible symmetry-adapted basis (q+,u+,v+,q-,u-,v-). The conjugation has exactly zero cross-blocks and yields the stated G_plus and G_minus. Independent SymPy expansion checks G_plus has positive coefficients c1,c2,c3 (8,17,10 monomials) and strictly positive 86-term cubic Hurwitz margin. G_minus has positive c1,c2 (7,12 monomials), strictly positive 56-term margin and c3=alpha*Delta where Delta=nu*(gamma+rho+tau)-gamma*tau. The determinant is c3+*c3-. Routh-Hurwitz gives stability for Delta>0 and strict stability of G+ always; at Delta=0 the antisymmetric cubic is z*(z²+c1 z+c2) with one simple zero and the remaining quadratic strictly stable; at Delta<0 Descartes and Vieta imply exactly one positive real eigenvalue and remaining two strictly stable. Therefore no nonzero imaginary-axis eigenvalue anywhere on the positive fixed slice. Three sample parameter choices were independently tested as corroboration, not a universal proof.
